info.description: Open-weight multimodal model with 1.55B parameters. The docs list a 256K context and support for single-image, multi-image, and video understanding. Thinking is switched with enable_thinking; no effort values are listed. OpenBMB is not in the abbreviation table, so 256K is not converted. The page does not publish a calendar date, a maximum output, a standard API price, or a first-party request URL.

zh.description: 开放权重多模态模型，参数 1.55B。文档列出 256K 上下文，并支持单图、多图和视频理解。思考由 enable_thinking 开关控制，没有列出强度取值。OpenBMB 不在缩写换算表中，因此不换算 256K。页面没有给出日历日期、最大输出、API 标准价或第一方请求 URL。
